_comment: Synthetic parcels and quotes. All money is integer paise. All figures are HYPOTHESIS pricing from docs/PRICING_AND_UNIT_ECONOMICS.md, not validated market prices. Do not present any number here as a real quote.
_source: Shape matches CreateParcelRequest / Parcel / Quote in api/openapi.yaml.

parcels.description: A4 envelope with property registration papers
parcels.declared_value_note: Documents have no declared commercial value in this fixture. The cap is about what we would ever pay for, not what a paper is worth to its owner.
parcels._note: Happy path. Should match trip 0t1...001 (departs 01:30Z, arrives 07:00Z, window 02:00Z-10:00Z).

parcels.description: Sealed envelope with degree certificates and mark sheets
parcels._note: Restricted category: must return 202 with review_required=true and cannot be quoted until a human clears it. Fixture for API-PAR-06.

parcels.description: Sealed carton with two fabric swatch books
parcels._note: Rs.3,500 declared value (350000 paise). Under the Rs.5,000 pilot cap. Fixture for the value-cap boundary discussion.

parcels.description: Bound booklet with printed course material
parcels._note: Sits exactly on all three limits: 4.9 kg, 44 cm, 500000 paise. Must be accepted. A single unit over any of them must be rejected (TC-PAR-02/03/04).

breakdown.label: Traveller's share
breakdown.note: Paid to the traveller after delivery

quotes._note: HYPOTHESIS pricing. Components must sum exactly to total_paise. The arithmetic integrity of this fixture is asserted by the pricing property test, not by a hardcoded expectation.

money_rules: Every amount is an integer number of paise. No float literal may appear anywhere in this file or in code that reads it.
subtotal_paise + platform_fee_paise + tax_paise must equal total_paise exactly.
The server computes all amounts. A client-supplied amount is ignored, not validated.
The stored quote is immutable. Re-quoting creates a new row with a new formula_version if the formula changed.
